svg.title: cordova-cli layered architecture
svg.desc: Layered architecture for cordova-cli: entry layer (bin/cordova, cordova.js), command parsing layer (src/cli.js with nopt), help/info layer (src/help.js, src/info.js), and implementation layer delegated to cordova-lib, cordova-create, and cordova-common. Each layer depends only downward.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does a developer invoke the Cordova CLI?')
sendPrompt('What do bin/cordova and cordova.js do as the entry layer?')
g.text: bin/cordova · cordova.js — OS entry, shebang, bootstrap, export CLI surface

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does src/cli.js do as the command parsing layer?')
g.text: src/cli.js — parse args with nopt · global flags · config commands
handle help / version · dispatch to cordova-lib commands

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What do src/help.js and src/info.js provide?')
g.text: src/help.js — command usage text · src/info.js — environment diagnostics
Imported in src/cli.js:20–30 and cordova.js:20–31 — all platform/plugin/build logic lives here

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does cordova-lib implement for the Cordova CLI?')

svg.text: CLI layer depends on Cordova libraries — no platform/plugin/build logic implemented directly in the CLI
